indexing.name: Kyrgyzstan Lakes Dataset: Morphometry, Geography, Hydrology, Glacial-Lake Dynamics and Source Provenance
indexing.description: Kyrgyzstan Lakes Dataset v1.0.0 is a curated, source-traceable geographic and hydrological reference dataset covering selected lakes of Kyrgyzstan, published morphometry, glacial-lake dynamics, dated observations, drainage and outburst events, source lineage, conflicts, and national or regional lake-inventory statistics. The release contains 73 lake, lake-complex, and unresolved inventory entities, 166 source-specific morphometric measurement records, 37 referenced sources, 199 source-backed classifications, 5 inventory records, 12 aggregate statistics, and 16 explicit conflict or non-comparability cases. It also includes 129 audited selected reference measurements, of which 119 are public-eligible and 10 are deliberately withheld from the simplified public reference layer, plus 11 documented glacial-lake events, 26 dated lake observations, and 9 study-local ephemeral features. Kyrgyzstan Lakes Dataset separates lake entities from source-specific measurements and retains defensible alternative or conflicting values instead of silently overwriting them. Reference selection uses explicit comparability groups, source quality, observation dates, methods, and a separate public-release audit. Dynamic glacial lakes are represented through dated observations and event records where the evidence supports them. The dataset is curated rather than exhaustive and is not a complete national polygon inventory of every lake in Kyrgyzstan. The package includes UTF-8 CSV files, a point GeoJSON layer of source-traceable representative locations, a source registry, source-lineage table, conflict register, data dictionary, methodology, rights metadata, a Frictionless Data Package descriptor, CITATION.cff, validation report, public-file manifest, SHA-256 checksums, and workbook. The v1.0.0 validation report contains 110 checks with 0 failures. Dataset documentation and contextual guide: https://kyrgyzstanplanner.com/lakes-of-kyrgyzstan/
